about: Character-sheet lines for a townsperson who becomes a companion (dungeon/world/profile_bank.py), drawn by seed. 'careers' is keyed by career id (shared and city careers), 'staff' by the title someone holds at a place, 'sectors' by a career's sector as a fallback; each has three subject-less skill sentences. 'laughs' completes 'laughs at ...' and 'snaps' completes 'snaps when ...' (lowercase, no period); 'speech' and 'middling' are subject-less sentences. Lines never use a pronoun for the person and the four lists fit every era.
